chunks: If you reflect upon its digestive tracts, and its upper and lower parts, and what is in its cavity from the membranes of its belly, and what is in its head from its eyes and ears, you would be amazed by its creation, and you would find difficulty in describing it!
Exalted is He who made it stand on its legs, and built it on its pillars! No other originator shared with Him in its creation, and no one having power assisted Him in its creation.

And if you traverse the paths of your thought to reach its limits, guidance will not lead you except to the fact that the Originator of the ant is the same as the Originator of the date-palm, due to the minute detail of everything, and the obscure difference of every living being; and the great and the subtle, the heavy and the light, the strong and the weak, in His creation are all equal.
ai.seo_question: How does the creation of the ant demonstrate God's unity and power in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: Imam Ali employs the ant as a microcosm of creation to illustrate the concept of *Tawhid* (Divine Unity), arguing that the same Creator who fashioned the minute insect also built the towering date-palm. This passage highlights the precision of divine design (*dhaqīq tafṣīl*) and the absence of partners in creation, reinforcing the Shia theological emphasis on God's absolute sovereignty over both the trivial and the majestic.

en.sayed-ali-raza: If you have thought about its digestive tracts in its high and low parts, the carapace of its belly, and its eyes and its ears in its head you would be amazed at its creation and you would feel difficulty in describing it.
Exalted is He who made it stand on its legs and erected it on its pillars (of limbs). No other originator took part with Him in its origination and no one having power assisted Him in its creation.

If you tread on the paths of your imagination and reach its extremity it will not lead you anywhere except that the Originator of the ant is the same as He who is the Originator of the date-palm, because everything has (the same) delicacy and detail, and every living being has little difference. In His creation, the big, the delicate, the heavy, the light, the strong, the weak are all equal. [1]
